stations.title: Dorrit
stations.say: Where is the labour on bill 4417?

stations.title: Kasimir's program
stations.text: A page of errors, a hang, a wrong bill.

captions: Dorrit sends bill 4417 to a customer, and it charges nothing for Kasimir's 50 minutes.
Kasimir's program builds with a page of errors, hangs on an order, and gets bills wrong.
You read each fault from where it shows back to where it starts, and mend only that.
Now bill 4417 carries its labour, and the program builds and finishes every time.
Each fault was mended where it started. Next, saying no to what makes no sense.
